1	/-
2	  TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Formula
3	  The specification language, as data.
4	
5	  A rule is an AST, not a Lean proposition, for three downstream reasons: the gate inspects it
6	  (which atoms, which operators, which parameters, any bare literal), the export serializes it for
7	  the tooling outside Lean, and the evaluator computes a three-valued verdict from it on a trace. Variables are strings bound by the grounding
8	  to tracks, and by the bounded quantifiers below to regions and devices of a kind.
9	
10	  Atoms, primitives and concepts are referenced BY NAME (the Lean definition names of Atoms.lean
11	  and Primitives.lean, `family_name`; a concept's `drv_<family>_<name>`), with arguments that are variables, enumeration values spelled as in
12	  ATOMS.md, or naturals. Semantics.lean dispatches the names; the doctor checks every name resolves.
13	
14	  A quantifier over road users ranges over every road user of the scene, the bound ones included;
15	  `same a b` is how a body excludes the subject from "another road user".
16	
17	  The bounded quantifiers take their kind as an `Arg`: a rule spells it (`.lit "intersection"`),
18	  a concept fills it from a literal formal on expansion. `rises` is an edge against the previous
19	  observation, not a frame: it says nothing about what happened between two observations.
20	
21	  `cond φ a b` selects between two quantities. A comparison over it is decided wherever both
22	  selections decide it alike, so an unobserved φ leaves a verdict open only where the choice
23	  matters (`elimCond`, applied before evaluation).
24	
25	  Deliberately absent: `next` (frame-relative and meaningless under irregular sampling), any
26	  numeric literal without a unit, any way to call an arbitrary Lean function.
27	-/

173	-- The atom names a formula reads (for the gate, the manifest and the export): every leaf, the
174	-- measure of every window, and the kind of every quantifier with a literal kind.
175	mutual
176	  partial def termAtoms : Term → List String
177	    | .measure a _ => [a]
178	    | .quantity c _ ps => c :: (ps.flatMap termAtoms)
179	    | .distanceWhile _ φ => measureAtom .path :: atoms φ
180	    | .sinceRise φ => measureAtom .time :: atoms φ
181	    | .headingSince _ g ψ => "kin_yaw_rate" :: measureAtom .time :: (termAtoms g ++ atoms ψ)
182	    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => atoms φ ++ termAtoms t
183	    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => termAtoms a ++ termAtoms b
184	    | .neg a | .abs a => termAtoms a
185	    | .cond φ a b => atoms φ ++ termAtoms a ++ termAtoms b
186	    | _ => []
187	  partial def atoms : Formula → List String
188	    | .atom n _ ps => n :: ps.flatMap termAtoms
189	    | .cmp l _ r => termAtoms l ++ termAtoms r
190	    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => atoms φ
191	    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => atoms φ ++ atoms ψ
192	    | .holdsFor m d _ φ | .within m d _ φ => measureAtom m :: termAtoms d ++ atoms φ
193	    | .untilWithin m d _ φ ψ => measureAtom m :: termAtoms d ++ atoms φ ++ atoms ψ
194	    | .atLast m d _ ψ φ => measureAtom m :: termAtoms d ++ atoms ψ ++ atoms φ
195	    | .count e s _ _ => atoms e ++ atoms s
196	    | .derived c _ ps => c :: ps.flatMap termAtoms
197	    | .existsRegion k _ φ | .forallRegion k _ φ => kindAtom "st_" k ++ atoms φ
198	    | .existsDevice k _ φ | .forallDevice k _ φ => kindAtom "dev_" k ++ atoms φ
199	    | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => atoms φ
200	    | _ => []

289	/-- A leaf is a subformula that reads the world or another rule: an atom, a comparison, an
290	    assumption, a derived concept or a composition. Leaves are numbered in traversal order. -/
291	def isLeaf : Formula → Bool
292	  | .atom .. | .cmp .. | .asm _ | .intent .. | .derived .. | .rule .. | .ruleApplies .. => true
293	  | _ => false

295	/-- The leaves in traversal order, as a description each. -/
296	partial def leaves : Formula → List String
297	  | .atom n args _ => [s!"atom {n} {repr args}"]
298	  | .cmp l _ r => [s!"cmp {repr l} {repr r}"]
299	  | .asm id => [s!"asm {id}"]
300	  | .intent id who target => [s!"intent {id} {repr who} {repr target}"]
301	  | .derived n args _ => [s!"derived {n} {repr args}"]
302	  | .rule id _ => [s!"rule {id}"]
303	  | .ruleApplies id _ => [s!"ruleApplies {id}"]
304	  | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => leaves φ
305	  | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => leaves φ ++ leaves ψ
306	  | .holdsFor _ _ _ φ | .within _ _ _ φ => leaves φ
307	  | .untilWithin _ _ _ φ ψ => leaves φ ++ leaves ψ
308	  | .atLast _ _ _ ψ φ => leaves ψ ++ leaves φ
309	  | .count e s _ _ => leaves e ++ leaves s
310	  | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
311	  | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => leaves φ
312	  | _ => []

314	def leafCount (φ : Formula) : Nat := (leaves φ).length
315	
316	/-- The formula with its `k`-th leaf (traversal order) replaced by `r`, and the number of leaves
317	    in the formula. A subformula whose leaves all precede or follow the `k`-th is returned as it is. -/
318	partial def replaceLeafAux (k : Nat) (r : Formula) : Formula → Formula × Nat
319	  | φ@(.atom ..) | φ@(.cmp ..) | φ@(.asm _) | φ@(.intent ..) | φ@(.derived ..) | φ@(.rule ..) | φ@(.ruleApplies ..) =>
320	    (if k = 0 then r else φ, 1)
321	  | .not φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.not φ', n)
322	  | .always φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.always φ', n)
323	  | .eventually φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.eventually φ', n)
324	  | .and φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.and φ' ψ', n)
325	  | .or φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.or φ' ψ', n)
326	  | .implies φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.implies φ' ψ', n)
327	  | .until φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.until φ' ψ', n)
328	  | .since φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.since φ' ψ', n)
329	  | .holdsFor m d s φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.holdsFor m d s φ', n)
330	  | .within m d s φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.within m d s φ', n)
331	  | .untilWithin m d s φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.untilWithin m d s φ' ψ', n)
332	  | .atLast m d s ψ φ => let (ψ', φ', n) := two k r ψ φ; (.atLast m d s ψ' φ', n)
333	  | .count e s op c => let (e', s', n) := two k r e s; (.count e' s' op c, n)
334	  | .rises φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.rises φ', n)
335	  | .definedWhen p φ => let (p', φ', n) := two k r p φ; (.definedWhen p' φ', n)
336	  | .existsRegion kd v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.existsRegion kd v φ', n)
337	  | .forallRegion kd v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.forallRegion kd v φ', n)
338	  | .existsDevice kd v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.existsDevice kd v φ', n)
339	  | .forallDevice kd v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.forallDevice kd v φ', n)
340	  | .existsUser v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.existsUser v φ', n)
341	  | .forallUser v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.forallUser v φ', n)
342	  | φ => (φ, 0)
343	where
344	  /-- Two subformulas in sequence: the right one is touched only when the target leaf lies in it. -/
345	  two (k : Nat) (r : Formula) (φ ψ : Formula) : Formula × Formula × Nat :=
346	    let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ
347	    if k < n then (φ', ψ, n + leafCount ψ)
348	    else let (ψ', m) := replaceLeafAux (k - n) r ψ; (φ', ψ', n + m)
349	
350	/-- The formula with its `k`-th leaf replaced by `r`. -/
351	def replaceLeaf (k : Nat) (r : Formula) (φ : Formula) : Formula := (replaceLeafAux k r φ).1

353	-- The assumptions and the declared intentions a formula reads, at any depth of formulas and terms.

355	  partial def termDeclared : Term → List (Sum AsmId IntId)

358	    | .headingSince _ g ψ => termDeclared g ++ declared ψ
359	    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => declared φ ++ termDeclared t
360	    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => termDeclared a ++ termDeclared b
361	    | .neg a | .abs a => termDeclared a
362	    | .cond φ a b => declared φ ++ termDeclared a ++ termDeclared b
363	    | _ => []

365	    | .asm id => [.inl id]
366	    | .intent id _ _ => [.inr id]
367	    | .atom _ _ ps | .derived _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termDeclared
368	    | .cmp l _ r => termDeclared l ++ termDeclared r
369	    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => declared φ
370	    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => declared φ ++ declared ψ
371	    | .holdsFor _ d _ φ | .within _ d _ φ => termDeclared d ++ declared φ
372	    | .untilWithin _ d _ φ ψ => termDeclared d ++ declared φ ++ declared ψ
373	    | .atLast _ d _ ψ φ => termDeclared d ++ declared ψ ++ declared φ
374	    | .count e s _ _ => declared e ++ declared s
375	    | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
376	    | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => declared φ

383	def intentions (φ : Formula) : List IntId := (declared φ).filterMap fun | .inr i => some i | .inl _ => none

385	-- The aggregate ids a formula names (`ru_aggregate x "<definition id>::<term>"`), at any depth of
386	-- formulas and terms, for the reading check.
387	mutual
388	  partial def termAggregateIds : Term → List String
389	    | .quantity _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termAggregateIds
390	    | .distanceWhile _ φ | .sinceRise φ => aggregateIds φ
391	    | .headingSince _ g ψ => termAggregateIds g ++ aggregateIds ψ
392	    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => aggregateIds φ ++ termAggregateIds t
393	    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => termAggregateIds a ++ termAggregateIds b
394	    | .neg a | .abs a => termAggregateIds a
395	    | .cond φ a b => aggregateIds φ ++ termAggregateIds a ++ termAggregateIds b
396	    | _ => []
397	  partial def aggregateIds : Formula → List String
398	    | .atom "ru_aggregate" [_, .lit w] ps => w :: ps.flatMap termAggregateIds
399	    | .atom _ _ ps | .derived _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termAggregateIds
400	    | .cmp l _ r => termAggregateIds l ++ termAggregateIds r
401	    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => aggregateIds φ
402	    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => aggregateIds φ ++ aggregateIds ψ
403	    | .holdsFor _ d _ φ | .within _ d _ φ => termAggregateIds d ++ aggregateIds φ
404	    | .untilWithin _ d _ φ ψ => termAggregateIds d ++ aggregateIds φ ++ aggregateIds ψ
405	    | .atLast _ d _ ψ φ => termAggregateIds d ++ aggregateIds ψ ++ aggregateIds φ
406	    | .count e s _ _ => aggregateIds e ++ aggregateIds s
407	    | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
408	    | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => aggregateIds φ
409	    | _ => []
410	end
411	
412	/-- The first `cond` of a term reachable through arithmetic (not inside an aggregate or a window,
413	    whose body ranges over its own variable or instants), with the term rebuilt on each branch. -/
414	partial def splitCond : Term → Option (Formula × Term × Term)
415	  | .cond φ a b => some (φ, a, b)
416	  | .add x y => two .add x y
417	  | .sub x y => two .sub x y
418	  | .mul x y => two .mul x y
419	  | .div x y => two .div x y
420	  | .neg x => (splitCond x).map fun (φ, a, b) => (φ, .neg a, .neg b)
421	  | .abs x => (splitCond x).map fun (φ, a, b) => (φ, .abs a, .abs b)
422	  | _ => none
423	where
424	  two (k : Term → Term → Term) (x y : Term) : Option (Formula × Term × Term) :=
425	    match splitCond x with
426	    | some (φ, a, b) => some (φ, k a y, k b y)
427	    | none => (splitCond y).map fun (φ, a, b) => (φ, k x a, k x b)
428	
429	/-- Every comparison over a `cond` rewritten by cases: `(φ ∧ A) ∨ (¬φ ∧ B) ∨ (A ∧ B)`, with `A` and
430	    `B` the comparison on each branch. Where φ is decided this is the selected branch; where φ is
431	    unknown it is decided exactly when both branches decide it alike. -/
432	partial def elimCond : Formula → Formula
433	  | .cmp l op r =>
434	    match splitCond l, splitCond r with
435	    | some (φ, a, b), _ => cases φ (.cmp a op r) (.cmp b op r)
436	    | none, some (φ, a, b) => cases φ (.cmp l op a) (.cmp l op b)
437	    | none, none => .cmp l op r
438	  | .not φ => .not (elimCond φ)
439	  | .and φ ψ => .and (elimCond φ) (elimCond ψ)
440	  | .or φ ψ => .or (elimCond φ) (elimCond ψ)
441	  | .implies φ ψ => .implies (elimCond φ) (elimCond ψ)
442	  | .always φ => .always (elimCond φ)
443	  | .eventually φ => .eventually (elimCond φ)
444	  | .until φ ψ => .until (elimCond φ) (elimCond ψ)
445	  | .since φ ψ => .since (elimCond φ) (elimCond ψ)
446	  | .holdsFor m d s φ => .holdsFor m d s (elimCond φ)
447	  | .within m d s φ => .within m d s (elimCond φ)
448	  | .untilWithin m d s φ ψ => .untilWithin m d s (elimCond φ) (elimCond ψ)
449	  | .atLast m d s ψ φ => .atLast m d s (elimCond ψ) (elimCond φ)
450	  | .count e s op n => .count (elimCond e) (elimCond s) op n
451	  | .rises φ => .rises (elimCond φ)
452	  | .definedWhen p φ => .definedWhen (elimCond p) (elimCond φ)
453	  | .existsUser v φ => .existsUser v (elimCond φ)
454	  | .forallUser v φ => .forallUser v (elimCond φ)
455	  | .existsRegion k v φ => .existsRegion k v (elimCond φ)
456	  | .forallRegion k v φ => .forallRegion k v (elimCond φ)
457	  | .existsDevice k v φ => .existsDevice k v (elimCond φ)
458	  | .forallDevice k v φ => .forallDevice k v (elimCond φ)
459	  | φ => φ
460	where
461	  cases (φ A B : Formula) : Formula :=
462	    let A := elimCond A; let B := elimCond B; let φ := elimCond φ
463	    .or (.or (.and φ A) (.and (.not φ) B)) (.and A B)
464	end Formula
465	
466	end TrafficSpec

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Formula
  The specification language, as data.

  A rule is an AST, not a Lean proposition, for three downstream reasons: the gate inspects it
  (which atoms, which operators, which parameters, any bare literal), the export serializes it for
  the tooling outside Lean, and the evaluator computes a three-valued verdict from it on a trace. Variables are strings bound by the grounding
  to tracks, and by the bounded quantifiers below to regions and devices of a kind.

  Atoms, primitives and concepts are referenced BY NAME (the Lean definition names of Atoms.lean
  and Primitives.lean, `family_name`; a concept's `drv_<family>_<name>`), with arguments that are variables, enumeration values spelled as in
  ATOMS.md, or naturals. Semantics.lean dispatches the names; the doctor checks every name resolves.

  A quantifier over road users ranges over every road user of the scene, the bound ones included;
  `same a b` is how a body excludes the subject from "another road user".

  The bounded quantifiers take their kind as an `Arg`: a rule spells it (`.lit "intersection"`),
  a concept fills it from a literal formal on expansion. `rises` is an edge against the previous
  observation, not a frame: it says nothing about what happened between two observations.

  `cond φ a b` selects between two quantities. A comparison over it is decided wherever both
  selections decide it alike, so an unobserved φ leaves a verdict open only where the choice
  matters (`elimCond`, applied before evaluation).

  Deliberately absent: `next` (frame-relative and meaningless under irregular sampling), any
  numeric literal without a unit, any way to call an arbitrary Lean function.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Params
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Time
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.World

namespace TrafficSpec

/-- A value a formula variable can denote. -/
inductive Val
  | track (t : TrackId)
  | region (r : RegionId)
  | device (d : DeviceId)
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

def Val.kind : Val → EntityKind
  | .track _ => .track
  | .region _ => .region
  | .device _ => .device

/-- Variable bindings (the grounding's output; `Env` is the world's environment record). -/
structure Binding where
  binds : List (String × Val) := []
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

namespace Binding
def lookup (e : Binding) (n : String) : Option Val := (e.binds.find? (·.1 == n)).map (·.2)
def bind (e : Binding) (n : String) (v : Val) : Binding := ⟨(n, v) :: e.binds.filter (·.1 != n)⟩
def track (e : Binding) (n : String) : Option TrackId :=
  match e.lookup n with | some (.track t) => some t | _ => none
def region (e : Binding) (n : String) : Option RegionId :=
  match e.lookup n with | some (.region r) => some r | _ => none
def device (e : Binding) (n : String) : Option DeviceId :=
  match e.lookup n with | some (.device d) => some d | _ => none
end Binding

/-- An argument to an atom or a derived concept. -/
inductive Arg
  | var (name : String)      -- a bound variable
  | lit (value : String)     -- an enumeration value, spelled as in the ontology
  | nat (n : Nat)
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

inductive CmpOp
  | lt | le | eq | ge | gt
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

/-- What an aggregate over road users computes. -/
inductive AggOp
  | min | max | median | count
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

def AggOp.toString : AggOp → String
  | .min => "min" | .max => "max" | .median => "median" | .count => "count"
instance : ToString AggOp := ⟨AggOp.toString⟩

def CmpOp.apply : CmpOp → Q → Q → Bool
  | .lt, a, b => Q.lt a b
  | .le, a, b => Q.le a b
  | .eq, a, b => Q.eq a b
  | .ge, a, b => Q.ge a b
  | .gt, a, b => Q.gt a b

mutual
  /-- A quantity. -/
  inductive Term
    | lit (q : Q) (unit : PUnit')                            -- written through a Units constructor
    | param (name : ParamName)                               -- a reading parameter
    | measure (atom : String) (args : List Arg)              -- a measured atom (Option Q or Option Nat)
    | quantity (concept : String) (args : List Arg) (params : List Term)   -- a Q-valued derived concept
    | distanceWhile (subject : String) (φ : Formula)         -- path length over which φ has held continuously
    | sinceRise (φ : Formula)                                -- time elapsed since φ last became true
    /-- The signed heading change (degrees, left positive) of `subject`, integrated from its yaw
        rate, since ψ last became true: from the latest observation at which ψ rose definitely (false
        at the observation before, true there), counted from zero at that observation. ψ turning false
        does not end it, nor does a stop; only the next definite rise of ψ starts it again. Unknown
        where no such rise is observed with ψ known at every observation since (an onset before the
        recording, or one an unknown value of ψ could hide), where an interval between consecutive
        observations from the one before the rise onwards is longer than `maxStep`, or where a yaw
        rate since the rise is missing. `maxStep` is a literal or a reading parameter, a time,
        strictly positive: the sampling standard of the integration, not a window and not a bound on
        how far back the onset may lie. -/
    | headingSince (subject : String) (maxStep : Term) (ψ : Formula)   -- the heading change of subject since ψ last became true
    | aggregate (op : AggOp) (var : String) (φ : Formula) (t : Term)   -- op of t over the road users var of the scene satisfying φ
    | add (a b : Term)
    | sub (a b : Term)
    | mul (a b : Term)
    /-- `a / b`, unknown wherever `b` is zero. Its divisor reads no measured atom: a measurement can
        be zero (a straight way's curvature, a halted road user's speed), so a bound on a ratio is
        written as a bound on a product (a ratio below a bound is the dividend below the bound
        times the divisor). -/
    | div (a b : Term)
    | neg (a : Term)
    | abs (a : Term)
    | cond (φ : Formula) (a b : Term)                        -- a where φ holds, b where it does not
  /-- A three-valued statement about the trace at an instant. -/
  inductive Formula
    | tt
    | ff
    | atom (name : String) (args : List Arg) (params : List Term)   -- a Boolean atom; params for tolerances
    | cmp (lhs : Term) (op : CmpOp) (rhs : Term)
    | asm (id : AsmId)
    | intent (id : IntId) (who target : Arg)                 -- the declaration current here: road user `who` intends `id` at region `target`
    | same (a b : Arg)                                        -- the two variables denote the same entity
    | not (φ : Formula)
    | and (φ ψ : Formula)
    | or (φ ψ : Formula)
    | implies (φ ψ : Formula)
    | always (φ : Formula)                                    -- from now to the end of the trace
    | eventually (φ : Formula)                                -- φ here or at some later observation, to the end of the trace
    | until (φ ψ : Formula)                                   -- strong until, future
    | since (φ ψ : Formula)                                   -- past mirror of until
    | holdsFor (m : Measure) (d : Term) (subject : String) (φ : Formula)   -- φ at every observation in the window behind
    | within (m : Measure) (d : Term) (subject : String) (φ : Formula)     -- φ at some observation in the window ahead
    | untilWithin (m : Measure) (d : Term) (subject : String) (φ ψ : Formula)   -- ψ at some observation in the window ahead, φ at every one before it
    | atLast (m : Measure) (d : Term) (subject : String) (ψ φ : Formula)   -- φ at the last observation in the window behind at which ψ held
    | count (edge : Formula) (sinceφ : Formula) (op : CmpOp) (n : Nat)   -- rising edges of `edge` since `sinceφ` became true (start of its latest run)
    | rises (φ : Formula)                                     -- φ here and not at the previous observation
    | definedWhen (pre φ : Formula)                           -- φ where `pre` holds; unknown (undefined) where it does not
    | derived (concept : String) (args : List Arg) (params : List Term)   -- a Boolean derived concept
    | rule (id : String) (map : List (String × String))       -- another rule complied with (not engaged counts as complied)
    | ruleApplies (id : String) (map : List (String × String)) -- another rule engaged (its binders' classes and applicability hold)
    | existsUser (var : String) (φ : Formula)                 -- some road user present in the scene
    | forallUser (var : String) (φ : Formula)
    | existsRegion (kind : Arg) (var : String) (φ : Formula)
    | forallRegion (kind : Arg) (var : String) (φ : Formula)
    | existsDevice (kind : Arg) (var : String) (φ : Formula)
    | forallDevice (kind : Arg) (var : String) (φ : Formula)
end

deriving instance Repr for Term
deriving instance Repr for Formula
instance : Inhabited Formula := ⟨.tt⟩
instance : Inhabited Term := ⟨.lit Q.zero .count⟩

namespace Formula
/-- The atom a window over a measure reads: the clock, or the subject's path length. -/
def measureAtom : Measure → String
  | .time => "kin_time"
  | .path => "kin_path_length"

/-- The kind atom a quantifier with a literal kind reads (`existsRegion (.lit "lane")` reads
    `st_lane`); a variable kind is a concept's literal formal, read once the instance fills it. -/
def kindAtom (prefix_ : String) : Arg → List String
  | .lit k => [prefix_ ++ k]
  | _ => []

-- The atom names a formula reads (for the gate, the manifest and the export): every leaf, the
-- measure of every window, and the kind of every quantifier with a literal kind.
mutual
  partial def termAtoms : Term → List String
    | .measure a _ => [a]
    | .quantity c _ ps => c :: (ps.flatMap termAtoms)
    | .distanceWhile _ φ => measureAtom .path :: atoms φ
    | .sinceRise φ => measureAtom .time :: atoms φ
    | .headingSince _ g ψ => "kin_yaw_rate" :: measureAtom .time :: (termAtoms g ++ atoms ψ)
    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => atoms φ ++ termAtoms t
    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => termAtoms a ++ termAtoms b
    | .neg a | .abs a => termAtoms a
    | .cond φ a b => atoms φ ++ termAtoms a ++ termAtoms b
    | _ => []
  partial def atoms : Formula → List String
    | .atom n _ ps => n :: ps.flatMap termAtoms
    | .cmp l _ r => termAtoms l ++ termAtoms r
    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => atoms φ
    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => atoms φ ++ atoms ψ
    | .holdsFor m d _ φ | .within m d _ φ => measureAtom m :: termAtoms d ++ atoms φ
    | .untilWithin m d _ φ ψ => measureAtom m :: termAtoms d ++ atoms φ ++ atoms ψ
    | .atLast m d _ ψ φ => measureAtom m :: termAtoms d ++ atoms ψ ++ atoms φ
    | .count e s _ _ => atoms e ++ atoms s
    | .derived c _ ps => c :: ps.flatMap termAtoms
    | .existsRegion k _ φ | .forallRegion k _ φ => kindAtom "st_" k ++ atoms φ
    | .existsDevice k _ φ | .forallDevice k _ φ => kindAtom "dev_" k ++ atoms φ
    | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => atoms φ
    | _ => []
end

-- The reading parameters a formula names.
mutual
  partial def termParams : Term → List ParamName
    | .param n => [n]
    | .quantity _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termParams
    | .distanceWhile _ φ => params φ
    | .sinceRise φ => params φ
    | .headingSince _ g ψ => termParams g ++ params ψ
    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => params φ ++ termParams t
    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => termParams a ++ termParams b
    | .neg a | .abs a => termParams a
    | .cond φ a b => params φ ++ termParams a ++ termParams b
    | _ => []
  partial def params : Formula → List ParamName
    | .atom _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termParams
    | .cmp l _ r => termParams l ++ termParams r
    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => params φ
    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => params φ ++ params ψ
    | .holdsFor _ d _ φ | .within _ d _ φ => termParams d ++ params φ
    | .untilWithin _ d _ φ ψ => termParams d ++ params φ ++ params ψ
    | .atLast _ d _ ψ φ => termParams d ++ params ψ ++ params φ
    | .count e s _ _ => params e ++ params s
    | .derived _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termParams
    | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
    | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => params φ
    | _ => []
end

-- The rules a formula composes, with each call's binder map, at any depth of formulas and terms.
mutual
  partial def termCompositions : Term → List (String × List (String × String))
    | .quantity _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termCompositions
    | .distanceWhile _ φ | .sinceRise φ => compositions φ
    | .headingSince _ g ψ => termCompositions g ++ compositions ψ
    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => compositions φ ++ termCompositions t
    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => termCompositions a ++ termCompositions b
    | .neg a | .abs a => termCompositions a
    | .cond φ a b => compositions φ ++ termCompositions a ++ termCompositions b
    | _ => []
  partial def compositions : Formula → List (String × List (String × String))
    | .rule id map | .ruleApplies id map => [(id, map)]
    | .atom _ _ ps | .derived _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termCompositions
    | .cmp l _ r => termCompositions l ++ termCompositions r
    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => compositions φ
    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => compositions φ ++ compositions ψ
    | .holdsFor _ d _ φ | .within _ d _ φ => termCompositions d ++ compositions φ
    | .untilWithin _ d _ φ ψ => termCompositions d ++ compositions φ ++ compositions ψ
    | .atLast _ d _ ψ φ => termCompositions d ++ compositions ψ ++ compositions φ
    | .count e s _ _ => compositions e ++ compositions s
    | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
    | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => compositions φ
    | _ => []
end

/-- The rules a formula composes. -/
def composed (φ : Formula) : List String := (compositions φ).map (·.1)

-- Numeric literals other than zero, with their units: what the gate holds against the node's
-- declared parameters (a magnitude belongs in the reading, not in a rule).
mutual
  partial def termLiterals : Term → List (Q × PUnit')
    | .lit q u => if Q.isZero q then [] else [(q, u)]
    | .quantity _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termLiterals
    | .distanceWhile _ φ => literals φ
    | .sinceRise φ => literals φ
    | .headingSince _ g ψ => termLiterals g ++ literals ψ
    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => literals φ ++ termLiterals t
    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => termLiterals a ++ termLiterals b
    | .neg a | .abs a => termLiterals a
    | .cond φ a b => literals φ ++ termLiterals a ++ termLiterals b
    | _ => []
  partial def literals : Formula → List (Q × PUnit')
    | .atom _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termLiterals
    | .cmp l _ r => termLiterals l ++ termLiterals r
    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => literals φ
    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => literals φ ++ literals ψ
    | .holdsFor _ d _ φ | .within _ d _ φ => termLiterals d ++ literals φ
    | .untilWithin _ d _ φ ψ => termLiterals d ++ literals φ ++ literals ψ
    | .atLast _ d _ ψ φ => termLiterals d ++ literals ψ ++ literals φ
    | .count e s _ _ => literals e ++ literals s
    | .derived _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termLiterals
    | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
    | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => literals φ
    | _ => []
end

/-- A leaf is a subformula that reads the world or another rule: an atom, a comparison, an
    assumption, a derived concept or a composition. Leaves are numbered in traversal order. -/
def isLeaf : Formula → Bool
  | .atom .. | .cmp .. | .asm _ | .intent .. | .derived .. | .rule .. | .ruleApplies .. => true
  | _ => false

/-- The leaves in traversal order, as a description each. -/
partial def leaves : Formula → List String
  | .atom n args _ => [s!"atom {n} {repr args}"]
  | .cmp l _ r => [s!"cmp {repr l} {repr r}"]
  | .asm id => [s!"asm {id}"]
  | .intent id who target => [s!"intent {id} {repr who} {repr target}"]
  | .derived n args _ => [s!"derived {n} {repr args}"]
  | .rule id _ => [s!"rule {id}"]
  | .ruleApplies id _ => [s!"ruleApplies {id}"]
  | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => leaves φ
  | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => leaves φ ++ leaves ψ
  | .holdsFor _ _ _ φ | .within _ _ _ φ => leaves φ
  | .untilWithin _ _ _ φ ψ => leaves φ ++ leaves ψ
  | .atLast _ _ _ ψ φ => leaves ψ ++ leaves φ
  | .count e s _ _ => leaves e ++ leaves s
  | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
  | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => leaves φ
  | _ => []

def leafCount (φ : Formula) : Nat := (leaves φ).length

/-- The formula with its `k`-th leaf (traversal order) replaced by `r`, and the number of leaves
    in the formula. A subformula whose leaves all precede or follow the `k`-th is returned as it is. -/
partial def replaceLeafAux (k : Nat) (r : Formula) : Formula → Formula × Nat
  | φ@(.atom ..) | φ@(.cmp ..) | φ@(.asm _) | φ@(.intent ..) | φ@(.derived ..) | φ@(.rule ..) | φ@(.ruleApplies ..) =>
    (if k = 0 then r else φ, 1)
  | .not φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.not φ', n)
  | .always φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.always φ', n)
  | .eventually φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.eventually φ', n)
  | .and φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.and φ' ψ', n)
  | .or φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.or φ' ψ', n)
  | .implies φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.implies φ' ψ', n)
  | .until φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.until φ' ψ', n)
  | .since φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.since φ' ψ', n)
  | .holdsFor m d s φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.holdsFor m d s φ', n)
  | .within m d s φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.within m d s φ', n)
  | .untilWithin m d s φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.untilWithin m d s φ' ψ', n)
  | .atLast m d s ψ φ => let (ψ', φ', n) := two k r ψ φ; (.atLast m d s ψ' φ', n)
  | .count e s op c => let (e', s', n) := two k r e s; (.count e' s' op c, n)
  | .rises φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.rises φ', n)
  | .definedWhen p φ => let (p', φ', n) := two k r p φ; (.definedWhen p' φ', n)
  | .existsRegion kd v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.existsRegion kd v φ', n)
  | .forallRegion kd v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.forallRegion kd v φ', n)
  | .existsDevice kd v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.existsDevice kd v φ', n)

  | .since φ ψ => .since (elimCond φ) (elimCond ψ)
  | .holdsFor m d s φ => .holdsFor m d s (elimCond φ)
  | .within m d s φ => .within m d s (elimCond φ)
  | .untilWithin m d s φ ψ => .untilWithin m d s (elimCond φ) (elimCond ψ)
  | .atLast m d s ψ φ => .atLast m d s (elimCond ψ) (elimCond φ)
  | .count e s op n => .count (elimCond e) (elimCond s) op n
  | .rises φ => .rises (elimCond φ)
  | .definedWhen p φ => .definedWhen (elimCond p) (elimCond φ)
  | .existsUser v φ => .existsUser v (elimCond φ)
  | .forallUser v φ => .forallUser v (elimCond φ)
  | .existsRegion k v φ => .existsRegion k v (elimCond φ)
  | .forallRegion k v φ => .forallRegion k v (elimCond φ)
  | .existsDevice k v φ => .existsDevice k v (elimCond φ)
  | .forallDevice k v φ => .forallDevice k v (elimCond φ)
  | φ => φ
where
  cases (φ A B : Formula) : Formula :=
    let A := elimCond A; let B := elimCond B; let φ := elimCond φ
    .or (.or (.and φ A) (.and (.not φ) B)) (.and A B)

402	/-- The rectangle a road user's body covers on the ground, from its position, heading and
403	    half-extents; `none` when one of them is not observed. -/
404	def footprint (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option (List Vec) := do
405	  let p ← kin_position s x
406	  let h ← kin_heading s x
407	  let (hl, hw, _) ← kin_extent s x
408	  let u ← Geom.unit h
409	  let v := (Q.neg u.2, u.1)
410	  let corner (a b : Q) : Vec := Geom.vadd p (Q.add (Q.mul a u.1) (Q.mul b v.1), Q.add (Q.mul a u.2) (Q.mul b v.2))
411	  pure [corner hl hw, corner hl (Q.neg hw), corner (Q.neg hl) (Q.neg hw), corner (Q.neg hl) hw]

413	/-- Ground distance from a road user's body to a region: zero when the footprint overlaps the
414	    boundary, otherwise the nearest approach between the two outlines. Without a footprint (no
415	    extent or heading observed) the reference point is used; a point-like structure is measured
416	    to its reference point. -/
417	def st_region_geometry_distance (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (r : RegionId) : Option Q := do
418	  let p ← kin_position s x
419	  match st_region_geometry_boundary s r, footprint s x with
420	  | some poly, some fp =>
421	    if Geom.polygonsOverlap fp poly then some Q.zero
422	    else
423	      let ds := fp.filterMap (Geom.polygonDistance · poly) ++ poly.filterMap (Geom.polygonDistance · fp)
424	      ds.foldl (fun acc d => match acc with | none => some d | some a => some (Q.min a d)) none
425	  | some poly, none => Geom.polygonDistance p poly
426	  | none, fp =>
427	    let c ← st_region_geometry_position s r
428	    match fp with
429	    | some poly => Geom.polygonDistance c poly
430	    | none => some (Geom.norm (Geom.vsub c p))

535	def rel_centre_distance (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q :=
536	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.centreDistance) with
537	  | some d => some d

539	    let pa ← kin_position s a

543	/-- Components of `b`'s position relative to `a` in `a`'s heading frame (longitudinal, lateral). -/
544	private def relFrame (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option (Q × Q) := do
545	  let pa ← kin_position s a
546	  let pb ← kin_position s b
547	  let ha ← kin_heading s a
548	  Geom.inFrame ha (Geom.vsub pb pa)
549	
550	/-- The gap between the two bodies: the vector from the nearest point of `a`'s footprint to the
551	    nearest point of `b`'s, each footprint read with its own heading and extent, given as its
552	    lengths along and across `a`'s heading (longitudinal, lateral). Neither is ever negative; both
553	    are zero exactly when the footprints touch or overlap. `none` when either footprint is not
554	    observed, and when a supplied gap has a negative component. -/
555	def rel_surface_gap (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option (Q × Q) :=
556	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.surfaceGap) with
557	  | some g => if Q.isNonneg g.1 && Q.isNonneg g.2 then some g else none
558	  | none => do
559	    let fa ← footprint s a
560	    let fb ← footprint s b
561	    let d ← Geom.nearestOffset fa fb
562	    let ha ← kin_heading s a
563	    let (lon, lat) ← Geom.inFrame ha d
564	    pure (Q.abs lon, Q.abs lat)
565	def rel_surface_gap_longitudinal (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map (·.1)
566	def rel_surface_gap_lateral (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map (·.2)
567	/-- The distance between the nearest points of the two bodies, the gap's length: zero on contact
568	    or overlap, never negative. -/
569	def rel_surface_gap_distance (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map Geom.norm
570	
571	/-- `a` and `b` share a lane and `a` is ahead of `b` along `a`'s heading. The lane is any region both
572	    occupy that is of kind lane (`Structure.isOfKind`): unknown when `a` is ahead and no shared region
573	    is known to be a lane but one may be. -/
574	def rel_ahead_behind_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool :=
575	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.aAheadOfB) with
576	  | some v => some v
577	  | none => do
578	    let ra ← rel_occupies_regions s a
579	    let rb ← rel_occupies_regions s b
580	    let (lon, _) ← relFrame s a b
581	    if !Q.lt lon Q.zero then some false
582	    else
583	      let shared := (s.structures.filter fun st => ra.contains st.id && rb.contains st.id).map (·.isOfKind .lane)
584	      if shared.contains (some true) then some true
585	      else if shared.contains none then none
586	      else some false

588	def rel_behind_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := rel_ahead_behind_in_lane s b a

590	/-- Signed overlap of the two footprints along `a`'s heading, each read with its own heading and
591	    extent: the length their projections on that axis share, positive when the bodies are side by
592	    side, otherwise the gap between the projections negated. A projection: it reads nothing across
593	    the axis, so a positive value is no contact and a negative one no distance between the bodies. -/
594	def rel_longitudinal_overlap (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q :=
595	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.longitudinalOverlap) with
596	  | some v => some v
597	  | none => do
598	    let pa ← kin_position s a
599	    let ha ← kin_heading s a
600	    let u ← Geom.unit ha
601	    let fa ← footprint s a
602	    let fb ← footprint s b
603	    let (loA, hiA) ← Geom.span u pa fa
604	    let (loB, hiB) ← Geom.span u pa fb
605	    pure (Q.sub (Q.min hiA hiB) (Q.max loA loB))

607	/-- Headings opposed (cosine below `-cosTol`) and the distance decreasing. -/
608	def rel_oncoming (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (cosTol : Q) : Option Bool :=
609	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.oncoming) with
610	  | some v => some v
611	  | none => do
612	    let ha ← kin_heading s a
613	    let hb ← kin_heading s b
614	    let pa ← kin_position s a
615	    let pb ← kin_position s b
616	    let va ← kin_velocity s a
617	    let vb ← kin_velocity s b
618	    let ua ← Geom.unit ha
619	    let ub ← Geom.unit hb
620	    let closing := Q.lt (Geom.dot (Geom.vsub pb pa) (Geom.vsub vb va)) Q.zero
621	    pure (Q.lt (Geom.dot ua ub) (Q.neg cosTol) && closing)

624	def rel_same_direction (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (cosTol : Q) : Option Bool :=
625	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.sameDirection) with
626	  | some v => some v
627	  | none => do
628	    let ha ← kin_heading s a
629	    let hb ← kin_heading s b
630	    let ua ← Geom.unit ha
631	    let ub ← Geom.unit hb
632	    pure (Q.gt (Geom.dot ua ub) cosTol)
633

635	def rel_bearing (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Vec :=
636	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.bearing) with
637	  | some v => some v
638	  | none => relFrame s a b
639	def rel_bearing_right (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.lt v.2 Q.zero
640	def rel_bearing_left (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.gt v.2 Q.zero
641	def rel_bearing_ahead (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.gt v.1 Q.zero
642	def rel_bearing_behind (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.lt v.1 Q.zero
643

645	def rel_contact (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool :=

647	  | some v => some v
648	  | none => (rel_surface_gap s a b).map fun g => Q.le g.1 Q.zero && Q.le g.2 Q.zero

651	def rel_visible (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.relation a b).bind (·.visible)

import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.World
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Assumptions

namespace TrafficSpec

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Geometry helpers for the `rel_*` atoms (exact rationals; the one square root is an integer
-- square root at micrometre resolution).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
namespace Geom
def vsub (a b : Vec) : Vec := (Q.sub a.1 b.1, Q.sub a.2 b.2)
def vadd (a b : Vec) : Vec := (Q.add a.1 b.1, Q.add a.2 b.2)
def dot (a b : Vec) : Q := Q.add (Q.mul a.1 b.1) (Q.mul a.2 b.2)
/-- 2-D cross product `a × b`; positive when `b` is to the left of `a`. -/
def cross (a b : Vec) : Q := Q.sub (Q.mul a.1 b.2) (Q.mul a.2 b.1)
def normSq (a : Vec) : Q := dot a a
/-- Square root of a non-negative quantity in metres, floored to micrometres. -/
def sqrtMicro (q : Q) : Q :=
  if q.num ≤ 0 then Q.zero
  else
    let scaled : Int := (q.num * 1000000000000) / (q.den : Int)   -- µm²
    Units.micrometres (Int.ofNat (isqrt scaled.toNat))
def norm (a : Vec) : Q := sqrtMicro (normSq a)
/-- The unit vector along `a`; `none` for the zero vector only. `a` is first divided by its larger
    absolute component, so the vector normalised has length between 1 and √2 whatever `a`'s scale,
    and then by that length taken to micrometres (`norm`). The result is the exact unit vector times
    a factor of at least 1 and below 1 + 2·10⁻⁶, and is exact where the scaled length is a whole
    number of micrometres (every axis-aligned direction). -/
def unit (a : Vec) : Option Vec :=
  let m := Q.max (Q.abs a.1) (Q.abs a.2)
  if Q.isZero m then none
  else
    let b := (Q.div a.1 m, Q.div a.2 m)
    let n := norm b
    some (Q.div b.1 n, Q.div b.2 n)
/-- Components of `v` in the frame of heading `h` (longitudinal, lateral); lateral positive = left.
    `h` is read as a direction (`unit`), whatever its length; `v` keeps its own. -/
def inFrame (h v : Vec) : Option (Q × Q) := do
  let u ← unit h
  pure (dot u v, cross u v)
/-- Distance from a point to a segment. -/
def segmentDistance (p a b : Vec) : Q :=
  let ab := vsub b a
  let ap := vsub p a
  let l2 := normSq ab
  if Q.isZero l2 then norm ap
  else
    let t := Q.max Q.zero (Q.min (Q.ofInt 1) (Q.div (dot ap ab) l2))
    norm (vsub p (vadd a (Q.mul t ab.1, Q.mul t ab.2)))
/-- Whether a point lies inside a polygon (ray casting), for footprint-in-region tests. -/
def inPolygon (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
  let n := poly.length
  if n < 3 then false
  else
    let edges := (List.range n).map fun i => (poly[i]!, poly[(i + 1) % n]!)
    let crossings := edges.filter fun (a, b) =>
      let (ax, ay) := a; let (bx, by_) := b
      ((Q.le ay p.2) != (Q.le by_ p.2)) &&
        -- x-intersection of the edge with the horizontal line through p, compared with p.x
        (let dy := Q.sub by_ ay
         !Q.isZero dy &&
         Q.lt p.1 (Q.add ax (Q.div (Q.mul (Q.sub p.2 ay) (Q.sub bx ax)) dy)))
    crossings.length % 2 == 1
/-- The sign of `(b − a) × (c − a)`: 1 when `c` is to the left of `ab`, −1 to its right, 0 on its line. -/
def orient (a b c : Vec) : Int :=
  let k := (cross (vsub b a) (vsub c a)).num
  if k > 0 then 1 else if k < 0 then -1 else 0
/-- Whether `p` lies on the closed segment `ab`, given that it lies on its line. -/
def withinBox (p a b : Vec) : Bool :=
  Q.le (Q.min a.1 b.1) p.1 && Q.le p.1 (Q.max a.1 b.1) && Q.le (Q.min a.2 b.2) p.2 && Q.le p.2 (Q.max a.2 b.2)
/-- Whether the closed segments `ab` and `cd` share a point, touching and collinear overlap included. -/
def segmentsIntersect (a b c d : Vec) : Bool :=
  let o1 := orient a b c; let o2 := orient a b d; let o3 := orient c d a; let o4 := orient c d b
  (o1 * o2 < 0 && o3 * o4 < 0) || (o1 == 0 && withinBox c a b) || (o2 == 0 && withinBox d a b)
    || (o3 == 0 && withinBox a c d) || (o4 == 0 && withinBox b c d)
/-- The edges of a polygon, the last vertex closing to the first. -/
def edges (poly : List Vec) : List (Vec × Vec) :=
  let n := poly.length
  (List.range n).map fun i => (poly[i]!, poly[(i + 1) % n]!)
/-- Whether two polygons share a point as closed sets: an edge of one meets an edge of the other
    (touching counts), or one lies inside the other. Exact. -/
def polygonsOverlap (p q : List Vec) : Bool :=
  (edges p).any (fun (a, b) => (edges q).any fun (c, d) => segmentsIntersect a b c d)
    || p.any (inPolygon · q) || q.any (inPolygon · p)
/-- Distance from a point to a polygon's boundary: zero inside, the nearest edge outside. -/
def polygonDistance (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option Q :=
  match poly with
  | [] => none
  | [a] => some (norm (vsub p a))
  | _ =>
    if inPolygon p poly then some Q.zero
    else
      let n := poly.length
      let ds := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentDistance p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
      ds.foldl (fun acc d => match acc with | none => some d | some a => some (Q.min a d)) none
/-- The point of a segment nearest a point. -/
def segmentNearest (p a b : Vec) : Vec :=
  let ab := vsub b a
  let l2 := normSq ab
  if Q.isZero l2 then a
  else
    let t := Q.max Q.zero (Q.min (Q.ofInt 1) (Q.div (dot (vsub p a) ab) l2))
    vadd a (Q.mul t ab.1, Q.mul t ab.2)
/-- The point of a polygon's boundary nearest a point. -/
def nearestPoint (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option Vec :=
  match poly with
  | [] => none
  | [a] => some a
  | _ =>
    let n := poly.length
    let cs := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentNearest p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
    cs.foldl (fun acc c => match acc with
      | none => some c
      | some b => if Q.lt (normSq (vsub p c)) (normSq (vsub p b)) then some c else some b) none
/-- Every point of a polygon's boundary nearest a point: the nearest point of each edge whose
    distance is the least, so a tie keeps every equally near point whatever the vertex order. -/
def nearestPoints (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : List Vec :=
  match poly with
  | [] => []
  | [a] => [a]
  | _ =>
    let n := poly.length
    let cs := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentNearest p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
    match cs.map fun c => normSq (vsub p c) with
    | [] => []
    | d :: ds =>
      let m := ds.foldl Q.min d
      cs.filter fun c => Q.eq (normSq (vsub p c)) m
/-- The vector from the nearest point of polygon `p` to the nearest point of polygon `q`: zero when
    they share a point (`polygonsOverlap`), otherwise the shortest vector joining a vertex of one to
    the nearest point of the other's boundary, which for two convex polygons is the same for every
    nearest pair. `none` for an empty polygon. -/
def nearestOffset (p q : List Vec) : Option Vec :=
  if polygonsOverlap p q then some (Q.zero, Q.zero)
  else
    let fromP := p.filterMap fun c => (nearestPoint c q).map (vsub · c)
    let fromQ := q.filterMap fun c => (nearestPoint c p).map (vsub c ·)
    (fromP ++ fromQ).foldl (fun acc d => match acc with
      | none => some d
      | some e => if Q.lt (normSq d) (normSq e) then some d else some e) none
/-- The interval a polygon covers along the direction `u`, measured from `o`: (lowest, highest). -/
def span (u o : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option (Q × Q) :=
  match poly.map fun c => dot u (vsub c o) with
  | [] => none
  | x :: xs => some (xs.foldl Q.min x, xs.foldl Q.max x)
/-- Twice the signed area of a polygon (the shoelace sum). -/
def area2 (poly : List Vec) : Q :=
  (edges poly).foldl (fun acc (a, b) => Q.add acc (cross a b)) Q.zero
/-- Whether a polygon's boundary crosses or touches itself: two edges that are not neighbours
    meet, or two neighbouring edges fold back along one line. -/
def selfIntersects (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
  let es := (edges poly).toArray
  let n := es.size
  (List.range n).any fun i => (List.range n).any fun j =>
    if j ≤ i then false
    else
      let (a, b) := es[i]!
      let (c, d) := es[j]!
      if j == i + 1 then orient a b d == 0 && Q.lt (dot (vsub b a) (vsub d c)) Q.zero
      else if i == 0 && j + 1 == n then orient c d b == 0 && Q.lt (dot (vsub d c) (vsub b a)) Q.zero
      else segmentsIntersect a b c d
/-- A simple polygon: at least three vertices, a non-zero area, and a boundary that neither crosses
    nor touches itself (a repeated vertex makes two edges that are not neighbours meet). -/
def simplePolygon (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
  poly.length ≥ 3 && !Q.isZero (area2 poly) && !selfIntersects poly
/-- Whether a point lies on a polygon's boundary. Exact. -/
def onBoundary (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
  (edges poly).any fun (a, b) => orient a b p == 0 && withinBox p a b
/-- The parameters `t` at which the line `p + t·u` meets the polygon's boundary: one per edge it
    crosses or touches, and both ends of an edge it runs along. `u` is not the zero vector. -/
def lineCrossings (p u : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : List Q :=
  (edges poly).flatMap fun (a, b) =>
    let d := vsub b a
    let w := vsub a p
    let den := cross u d
    if Q.isZero den then
      if Q.isZero (cross u w) then [Q.div (dot w u) (dot u u), Q.div (dot (vsub b p) u) (dot u u)] else []
    else
      let s := Q.div (cross w u) den
      if Q.le Q.zero s && Q.le s (Q.ofInt 1) then [Q.div (cross w d) den] else []
end Geom

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Road users
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
private def hasClass (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (c : RoadUserClass) : Option Bool :=
  (s.user x).bind fun u => if u.unobservedClasses.contains c then none else u.classes.map (·.contains c)

def ru_motor_vehicle (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .motorVehicle
def ru_motorcycle (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .motorcycle
def ru_moped (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .moped
def ru_bus (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .bus
def ru_transit_bus (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .transitBus
def ru_school_bus (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .schoolBus
def ru_taxicab (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .taxicab
def ru_tour_bus_or_limousine (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .tourBusOrLimousine
def ru_truck (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .truck
def ru_commercial_motor_vehicle (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .commercialMotorVehicle
def ru_trailer_or_combination (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .trailerOrCombination
def ru_bicycle (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .bicycle
def ru_electric_bicycle (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .electricBicycle
def ru_electric_scooter (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .electricScooter
def ru_pedestrian (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .pedestrian
def ru_pedestrian_with_white_cane_or_guide_animal (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .pedestrianWithWhiteCaneOrGuideAnimal
def ru_child (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .child
def ru_emergency_vehicle (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .emergencyVehicle
def ru_fire_apparatus (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .fireApparatus
def ru_official_vehicle (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .officialVehicle
def ru_rail_vehicle (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := hasClass s x .railVehicle

def ru_subject (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := s.subject.map (· == x)
/-- Whether the road user carries one of the listed classes: true when it carries one; unknown when
    none holds and a listed class is unobserved (or the classes were not observed at all); false
    otherwise. A legal aggregate's membership is read through it, once for the classes its
    definition includes and once for those it leaves unresolved. -/
def ru_aggregate (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (members : List RoadUserClass) : Option Bool :=
  (s.user x).bind fun u =>
    let has : List (Option Bool) := members.map fun c =>
      if u.unobservedClasses.contains c then none else u.classes.map (·.contains c)
    if has.any (· == some true) then some true
    else if has.any (·.isNone) then none
    else some false
def ru_occupant_count (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Nat := (s.user x).bind (·.occupants)
def ru_rider_posture (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Posture := (s.user x).map (·.posture)
def ru_rider_posture_on_seat (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.user x).bind (·.posture.onSeat)
def ru_rider_posture_hands_on_controls (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Nat := (s.user x).bind (·.posture.handsOnControls)
def ru_rider_posture_standing_on_deck (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.user x).bind (·.posture.standingOnDeck)
def ru_rider_posture_holding_another_vehicle (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.user x).bind (·.posture.holdingAnotherVehicle)

def ru_emergency_vehicle_kind (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option EmergencyKind := (s.user x).bind (·.emergencyKind)
def ru_official_vehicle_kind (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option OfficialKind := (s.user x).bind (·.officialKind)
def ru_electric_bicycle_class (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Nat := (s.user x).bind (·.eBikeClass)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Kinematics
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def kin_time (s : Scene) : Timestamp := s.t
def kin_position (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Vec := (s.user x).bind (·.kin.position)
def kin_heading (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Vec := (s.user x).bind (·.kin.heading)
def kin_velocity (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Vec := (s.user x).bind (·.kin.velocity)
def kin_speed (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Q := (s.user x).bind (·.kin.speed)

def kin_yaw_rate (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Q := (s.user x).bind (·.kin.yawRate)
def kin_extent (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option (Q × Q × Q) := (s.user x).bind (·.kin.extent)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Road structure and occupancy
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- Whether kind `a` refines kind `b`, reflexively and transitively. -/
def StructureKind.refines (a b : StructureKind) : Bool := a == b || a.ancestors.contains b

/-- Whether a source that cannot tell kind `m` (it is among `unobservedKinds`) leaves this structure's
    membership of `m`'s kinds open: always where `m` refines no kind other than an abstract one;
    otherwise only where the structure is labelled `m` or a kind `m` refines, since a structure of any
    other kind is known not to be one. -/
def Structure.maskApplies (st : Structure) (m : StructureKind) : Bool :=
  (m.parent?.filter (!·.isAbstract)).isNone || m.refines st.kind

/-- Whether a structure is of kind `k`: unknown where a kind the source cannot tell, applying to this
    structure, is `k` or a kind `k` refines (the label cannot be trusted for `k`); true where the
    structure's kind refines `k`; unknown where a kind the source cannot tell, applying to this
    structure, refines `k`; false otherwise. A parent never implies a kind refining it, two kinds
    refining one parent never imply each other, and a kind the source cannot tell never makes a known
    parent unknown. An abstract kind is the union of the kinds refining it: true where the structure
    is of one of them, unknown where it is of none and unknown for one, false otherwise. -/
def Structure.isOfKind (st : Structure) (k : StructureKind) : Option Bool :=
  let masked := st.unobservedKinds.filter st.maskApplies
  let concrete (k : StructureKind) : Option Bool :=
    if masked.any (k.refines ·) then none
    else if st.kind.refines k then some true
    else if masked.any (·.refines k) then none
    else some false
  if k.isAbstract then
    let vs := (StructureKind.all.filter (·.parent? == some k)).map concrete
    if vs.contains (some true) then some true else if vs.contains none then none else some false
  else concrete k

/-- Whether a region is of a kind (`Structure.isOfKind`); unknown for a region not in the scene. -/
def isKind (s : Scene) (r : RegionId) (k : StructureKind) : Option Bool :=
  (s.structure? r).bind (·.isOfKind k)

def st_highway (s : Scene) (r : RegionId) : Option Bool := isKind s r .highway
def st_travel_region (s : Scene) (r : RegionId) : Option Bool := isKind s r .travelRegion
def st_roadway (s : Scene) (r : RegionId) : Option Bool := isKind s r .roadway
def st_lane (s : Scene) (r : RegionId) : Option Bool := isKind s r .lane
def st_lane_direction (s : Scene) (r : RegionId) : Option Vec := (s.structure? r).bind (·.lane) |>.bind (·.direction)
def st_lane_adjacency (s : Scene) (r : RegionId) : Option LaneInfo := (s.structure? r).bind (·.lane)
def st_lane_adjacency_left (s : Scene) (r : RegionId) : Option RegionId := (st_lane_adjacency s r).bind (·.leftNeighbour)
def st_lane_adjacency_right (s : Scene) (r : RegionId) : Option RegionId := (st_lane_adjacency s r).bind (·.rightNeighbour)
def st_lane_adjacency_ordinal (s : Scene) (r : RegionId) : Option Nat := (st_lane_adjacency s r).bind (·.ordinalFromLeft)
def st_lane_adjacency_count (s : Scene) (r : RegionId) : Option Nat := (st_lane_adjacency s r).bind (·.countInDirection)
/-- Whether `r'` is lane `r`'s neighbour of the same direction on its left: decided false for every
    `r'` where `r` is first from the left, unknown where neither the neighbour nor the lane's place
    is observed. -/
def st_lane_left_of (s : Scene) (r r' : RegionId) : Option Bool :=
  match st_lane_adjacency_left s r with
  | some n => some (n == r')
  | none => if st_lane_adjacency_ordinal s r == some 1 then some false else none
/-- Whether `r'` is lane `r`'s neighbour of the same direction on its right: decided false for every
    `r'` where `r` is last of the lanes in its direction. -/
def st_lane_right_of (s : Scene) (r r' : RegionId) : Option Bool :=
  match st_lane_adjacency_right s r with

-- Relations between road users. Measured where the source supplies them, otherwise computed
-- from kinematics. `none` when a needed kinematic is missing.

def rel_centre_distance (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q :=

  | some d => some d
  | none => do
    let pa ← kin_position s a
    let pb ← kin_position s b
    pure (Geom.norm (Geom.vsub pb pa))

/-- Components of `b`'s position relative to `a` in `a`'s heading frame (longitudinal, lateral). -/
private def relFrame (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option (Q × Q) := do
  let pa ← kin_position s a
  let pb ← kin_position s b
  let ha ← kin_heading s a
  Geom.inFrame ha (Geom.vsub pb pa)

/-- The gap between the two bodies: the vector from the nearest point of `a`'s footprint to the
    nearest point of `b`'s, each footprint read with its own heading and extent, given as its
    lengths along and across `a`'s heading (longitudinal, lateral). Neither is ever negative; both
    are zero exactly when the footprints touch or overlap. `none` when either footprint is not
    observed, and when a supplied gap has a negative component. -/
def rel_surface_gap (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option (Q × Q) :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.surfaceGap) with
  | some g => if Q.isNonneg g.1 && Q.isNonneg g.2 then some g else none
  | none => do
    let fa ← footprint s a
    let fb ← footprint s b
    let d ← Geom.nearestOffset fa fb
    let ha ← kin_heading s a
    let (lon, lat) ← Geom.inFrame ha d
    pure (Q.abs lon, Q.abs lat)

def rel_surface_gap_lateral (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map (·.2)
/-- The distance between the nearest points of the two bodies, the gap's length: zero on contact
    or overlap, never negative. -/
def rel_surface_gap_distance (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map Geom.norm

/-- `a` and `b` share a lane and `a` is ahead of `b` along `a`'s heading. The lane is any region both
    occupy that is of kind lane (`Structure.isOfKind`): unknown when `a` is ahead and no shared region
    is known to be a lane but one may be. -/
def rel_ahead_behind_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.aAheadOfB) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => do
    let ra ← rel_occupies_regions s a
    let rb ← rel_occupies_regions s b
    let (lon, _) ← relFrame s a b
    if !Q.lt lon Q.zero then some false
    else
      let shared := (s.structures.filter fun st => ra.contains st.id && rb.contains st.id).map (·.isOfKind .lane)
      if shared.contains (some true) then some true
      else if shared.contains none then none
      else some false
def rel_ahead_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := rel_ahead_behind_in_lane s a b
def rel_behind_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := rel_ahead_behind_in_lane s b a

/-- Signed overlap of the two footprints along `a`'s heading, each read with its own heading and
    extent: the length their projections on that axis share, positive when the bodies are side by
    side, otherwise the gap between the projections negated. A projection: it reads nothing across
    the axis, so a positive value is no contact and a negative one no distance between the bodies. -/
def rel_longitudinal_overlap (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.longitudinalOverlap) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => do
    let pa ← kin_position s a
    let ha ← kin_heading s a
    let u ← Geom.unit ha
    let fa ← footprint s a
    let fb ← footprint s b
    let (loA, hiA) ← Geom.span u pa fa
    let (loB, hiB) ← Geom.span u pa fb
    pure (Q.sub (Q.min hiA hiB) (Q.max loA loB))

/-- Headings opposed (cosine below `-cosTol`) and the distance decreasing. -/
def rel_oncoming (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (cosTol : Q) : Option Bool :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.oncoming) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => do
    let ha ← kin_heading s a
    let hb ← kin_heading s b
    let pa ← kin_position s a
    let pb ← kin_position s b
    let va ← kin_velocity s a
    let vb ← kin_velocity s b
    let ua ← Geom.unit ha
    let ub ← Geom.unit hb
    let closing := Q.lt (Geom.dot (Geom.vsub pb pa) (Geom.vsub vb va)) Q.zero
    pure (Q.lt (Geom.dot ua ub) (Q.neg cosTol) && closing)

/-- Headings aligned (cosine above `cosTol`). -/
def rel_same_direction (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (cosTol : Q) : Option Bool :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.sameDirection) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => do
    let ha ← kin_heading s a
    let hb ← kin_heading s b
    let ua ← Geom.unit ha
    let ub ← Geom.unit hb
    pure (Q.gt (Geom.dot ua ub) cosTol)

/-- `b` relative to `a` in `a`'s frame: (longitudinal, lateral), lateral positive to the left. -/
def rel_bearing (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Vec :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.bearing) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => relFrame s a b
def rel_bearing_right (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.lt v.2 Q.zero
def rel_bearing_left (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.gt v.2 Q.zero
def rel_bearing_ahead (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.gt v.1 Q.zero
def rel_bearing_behind (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.lt v.1 Q.zero

/-- The bodies touch or overlap. -/
def rel_contact (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.contact) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => (rel_surface_gap s a b).map fun g => Q.le g.1 Q.zero && Q.le g.2 Q.zero

/-- `b` is in `a`'s line of sight, as the source tested it; never computed. -/
def rel_visible (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.relation a b).bind (·.visible)

end TrafficSpec
